item.text: [{"task_id":"9caba7c3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    grey = int(round(params['colours'][0]))","    red = int(round(params['colours'][1]))","    orange = int(round(params['colours'][2]))","    yellow = int(round(params['colours'][3]))","    offsets = [int(round(v)) for v in params['offsets']]","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    for r in range(height):","        for c in range(width):","            if grid[r, c] != grey:","                continue","            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr in offsets for dc in offsets]","            if not all(0 <= rr < height and 0 <= cc < width for rr, cc in cells):","                continue","            values = np.array([grid[rr, cc] for rr, cc in cells])","            if np.all(np.isin(values, [grey, red])) and np.any(values == red):","                for rr, cc in cells:","                    if grid[rr, cc] == grey:","                        out[rr, cc] = orange","                out[r, c] = yellow","    return out"],"shapes":{"colours":[4],"offsets":[3]},"params":{"colours":[5,2,7,4],"offsets":[-1,0,1]},"rationale":"Find every 3×3 square consisting entirely of grey and red, containing red and having a grey centre. Preserve its red cells, colour its remaining cells orange, and colour its centre yellow. All other cells remain unchanged."}]
